about: The room switched on by voice, a new person introduced out loud and then heard for the first time, and the room switched off again.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: Hi everyone, sorry I'm late, the traffic on the bridge was terrible tonight.

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text: This is my friend Mateo, he's staying with us for the week.

turns.speaker: Mateo
turns.text: Hi, nice to meet you all. Thanks for having me over for dinner tonight.

turns.speaker: Mateo
turns.text: I brought a bag of lemons from the tree at my place, if anyone wants some.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: Oh, lovely. We could make lemonade tomorrow afternoon if it stays warm.

turns.speaker: Mateo
turns.text: That sounds great. I haven't made lemonade since I was a kid.

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text: Okay, they've both headed home now. Solo mode, it's just me now.
